cars.label: NEAT 16
cars.title: NEAT 16: the proven recipe
cars.why:
The best NEAT recipe from the ladder (n05): 16 rays facing forward over ±120°, 2000-frame training episodes,
+1 fitness per frame a lap beats 1000 frames, population 100. Trained from scratch for up to 8 hours, stopping
early if the validation lap time has not improved for 2 hours.

cars.label: NEAT 32
cars.title: NEAT 32: twice the rays
cars.why:
Same as NEAT 16 but with 32 forward rays over the same ±120°: twice the detail ahead, but twice the inputs to evolve
and a slower simulation. Do more rays make a faster car, or only a slower-to-train one?

cars.label: NEAT Smart
cars.title: NEAT Smart: every lesson at once
cars.why:
NEAT 16 plus three lessons from the ladder. (1) No compass inputs: cos/sin(heading) are useless on random tracks,
and in n00 evolution had already cut cos(heading) off. (2) Five tracks per generation instead of three, so a network
can't win by drawing easy tracks. (3) A stronger lap-time bonus (2 per frame) to push harder for speed.
